texto: Many masculine professions end up in consonant (**водитель**, **строитель**, **бухгалтер**). Some feminine forms end in **-а** (**медсестра**); other professions are adjective in form and function as nouns (**полицейский**, **пожарный**). To express the profession with **работать**, the non-preposition instrument is used: **водитель → водителем**, **строитель → строителем**, **медсестра → медсестрой**. You can also now identify a profession with the nominee: **Моя мама — бухгалтер**.

frases.es: Mi hermano es conductor de autobús.

frases.ru: Моя мама — бухгалтер в большой компании.
frases.es: Mi madre es contable en una gran empresa.
frases.en: My mother's an accountant in a big company.

frases.es: Mi hermana trabaja como enfermera en el hospital.
frases.en: My sister works as a nurse at the hospital.

frases.ru: Мой друг — строитель, он строит дома.
frases.es: Mi amigo trabaja en la construcción; construye casas.
frases.en: My friend works in construction; he builds houses.

opciones.explicacion: The profession goes in instrumental and without preposition: водителем. On the other hand, working in + prepositional indicates the workplace, for example в больнице.
In the present, the profession is expressed with the nominee: бухгалтер.
The phrase speaks of the mother, not the father.
The profession of the phrase is бухгалтер, «contable».
Nominative: does not go after работает.
The form медсестре can be either dative or prepositional; here, with работать, the instrument медсестрой is needed.
